name: conductor
description: The runtime half of multi-lane orchestration: detect a lane that has drifted from its brief, decide relay-vs-re-scope-vs-pause, read a verdict you did not run, and hold the machine's real parallelism ceiling. Carries four measured deviation shapes — the control that pins a blocker in place, the report taken as fact, the stale premise, and the collision only visible after both lanes merge — and a learnings loop that writes to the consuming repo and graduates into .claude/roles/conductor.md.
